jobs.description:
This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.

She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.

The next step is to speak to Jack.

Job Title

Director, Analytics Engineering

Salary

$270k-$330k + Equity

Company Description

Current is a $1.5B valuation Series E consumer fintech platform in NYC building a proprietary core banking system to improve financial outcomes for over 6 million members.

Job Description

As Director of Analytics Engineering at Current, you will be the strategic architect and hands-on leader of our data transformation layer. You will define the vision for our BigQuery data warehouse, lead a high-performing team of analytics engineers, and partner with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable data models that power critical fintech insights.

Location

New York, USA

Why this role is remarkable

Lead the data strategy for a high-growth fintech serving 6 million members, directly impacting the financial lives of everyday Americans through a proprietary core banking platform.
Join a Series E company valued at $1.5B, offering the stability of a market leader alongside the rapid innovation of a result-driven startup environment.
Enjoy a unique "player-coach" leadership style where you define long-term organizational design while staying technically sharp through complex SQL and dbt model reviews.

What You Will Do

Drive the Analytics Engineering and BI roadmap, owning the P&L for data warehousing, modeling, and business intelligence tools across the entire organization.
Architect robust dimensional models and data marts in BigQuery using dbt and Airflow, ensuring absolute data integrity for downstream Looker analytics and executive reporting.
Scale and mentor a world-class team of analytics engineers, including distributed offshore members, while defining technical career ladders and fostering a culture of technical excellence.

The ideal candidate

Brings 10+ years of experience in data architecture or analytics engineering, including 5+ years leading high-velocity teams within enterprise-grade data warehouse environments.
Possesses expert-level mastery of SQL, Kimball/Star Schema methodologies, and modern tooling including dbt, BigQuery, Airflow, and Looker (LookML).
Demonstrates intermediate to advanced Python skills and deep experience translating complex technical data requirements for non-technical stakeholders in Finance, Credit, and Product teams.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

jobs.title: Product Engineering - Engineering Manager / Sr. Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Sprinter Health

At Sprinter Health, our mission is reimagining how people access care by bringing it directly to their homes.
Nearly 30% of patients in the U.S. skip preventive or chronic care simply because they can’t get to a doctor’s office. For many, the ER becomes their first touchpoint with the healthcare system—driving over $300B in avoidable costs every year.

By using the same technologies that power leading marketplace and last-mile platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most. So far, we’ve supported more than 2 million patients across 22 states, completed 130,000+ in-home visits, and maintained a 92 NPS
. Our team of clinicians, technologists, and operators have raised over $125M to date investors like a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel
and enjoy multi-year runway.

About The Role

Our engineering team has scaled from 12 to 40+ engineers in the past year, and we’re still growing fast. We’re looking for experienced mid- to senior-level Engineering Managers to help us navigate this next phase. You’ve led teams of around 10 engineers at varying levels, and you know how to build for scale—hiring, career development, mentorship, org design, and beyond. We have multiple teams tackling a wide range of technical challenges, and we’ll work with you to place you where your interests and strengths align.

Hybrid & Office Experience

We operate on a hybrid schedule, working from the office Monday through Thursday, with Fridays designated as work-from-anywhere days.

We care deeply about work-life balance and are happy to provide flexibility when life happens. We ask that employees be in the office Monday through Thursday to collaborate with their teams while maintaining flexibility where it matters most.

Lunch is provided every day, and the entire team takes an hour to eat together. It's one of the ways we stay connected outside of meetings. You'll usually find us playing a board game before getting back to work.

What You Will Do

Lead and grow a team of 8–12 engineers — recruiting, coaching, and guiding performance and career development.
Stay close to the work with a full-stack engineering background, providing technical direction and unblockers when needed.
Drive fast execution without compromising technical quality, especially in a high-growth, high-ambiguity environment.
Partner closely with Product, Operations, and Data to deliver measurable impact for the business and our users.
Shape team structure, culture, and processes as we continue to scale.

What You Have Done

3+ years of experience managing and growing engineering teams (8+ engineers), including hiring, mentoring, and performance management
5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a focus on full-stack development
Proven ability to balance fast-paced execution with technical excellence, particularly in startup or high-growth environments
Experience working cross-functionally with product, operations, and data teams to drive business and customer impact

What Gives You An Edge

Experience in health tech, healthcare operations, or logistics (supply/demand, forecasting, inventory, routing, scheduling)
Experience scaling backend systems to support rapid business growth and operational complexity
Hands-on experience with Big Data, data platforms, and data pipelines
Experience managing in mid-stage or growth-stage startups, particularly in logistics-heavy, scheduling-driven, or operationally complex environments
Understanding of data privacy, HIPAA compliance, and security best practices in healthcare or other regulated industries

Interview Process

We aim to complete the interview process between 2-3 weeks. It will usually consist of:
Recruiter Screen (30-Minutes)
Hiring Manager Introduction (30-Minutes)
Technical Assessment (45-Minutes)
Onsite Interview: Systems Design + Behavioral Interview + Lunch with the Team (3-hours)
References

What We Offer

Meaningful pre-IPO equity
Medical, dental, and vision plans 100% paid for you and your dependents
Flexible PTO + 10 paid holidays per year
401(k) with match
16-week parental leave policy for birthing parent, 8 weeks for all other parents
HSA + FSA contributions
Life insurance, plus short and long-term disability coverage
Free daily lunch in-office
Annual learning stipend

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Tombot is a robotics startup based in the greater Los Angeles area. Jennie, our robotic puppy, was named a Best of CES Award winner at CES 2026 and was designed to support more than 50 million seniors living with dementia worldwide. We are building the systems and team needed to bring these robotic companions to the people who need them most.

The Opportunity

Tombot is hiring a hands-on Director of Information Technology to build and lead the company’s IT function through its next stage of growth. This role will own the technology infrastructure, enterprise systems, security, service delivery, and operating processes that support our employees, business operations, and customer-facing systems.

You will initially serve as Tombot’s senior-most internal IT leader and primary IT resource. The right person is comfortable moving between strategy and execution, from setting the IT roadmap and advising executives to configuring systems, resolving operational issues, managing vendors, and preparing the function to scale.

What You Will Own

Develop and execute a practical IT roadmap aligned with company growth, product launch priorities, operational requirements, and available resources.
Design, administer, and improve cloud infrastructure, networks, endpoints, identity and access management, collaboration tools, backups, recovery procedures, and security controls.
Lead the selection, configuration, implementation, integration, and administration of CRM and ERP platforms, including Zoho applications.
Partner with Finance, Operations, Customer Experience, Sales, and other teams to convert business requirements into reliable system workflows and reporting.
Establish role-based access, multifactor authentication, device management, patching, monitoring, incident response, business continuity, disaster recovery, and data retention practices.
Build an effective help desk and service delivery model, including intake, prioritization, escalation, issue tracking, and service expectations.
Own employee technology onboarding and offboarding, account provisioning, equipment deployment, access changes, and timely access removal.
Create software approval, license management, hardware, asset tracking, inventory, documentation, and equipment lifecycle processes.
Manage office technology and equipment logistics for current and future locations, including networks, audiovisual systems, workstations, vendors, and contractors.
Evaluate and manage technology vendors, consultants, managed service providers, contracts, renewals, purchasing, and the IT budget.
Support the systems, deployment, and reliability needs associated with mobile applications, connected devices, and product updates in partnership with Engineering.
Identify operational, security, scalability, and resourcing gaps early, and present clear recommendations and tradeoffs to executive leadership.
Build the future IT organization, including role design, hiring, onboarding, coaching, delegation, and performance management.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must have the following experience and capabilities:
7 or more years of progressive information technology experience.
2 or more years leading an IT function, team, or major technology portfolio.
Experience building or significantly maturing an IT function in an early-stage, growth-stage, or rapidly scaling organization.
Hands-on experience implementing and integrating CRM and ERP platforms.
Broad technical experience across cloud infrastructure, systems administration, networks, endpoint management, identity and access management, cybersecurity, backup, and disaster recovery.
Experience establishing IT service management, asset management, software governance, vendor management, and documentation practices.
Experience planning and supporting physical office technology, including networks, equipment, vendors, and new-location setup.
Ability to independently manage multiple projects and operational priorities in a fast-moving, resource-conscious environment.
Strong business judgment and the ability to explain technical risks, decisions, and tradeoffs to nontechnical stakeholders.
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience administering Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, Zoho One, or related Zoho applications.
Experience in a regulated or compliance-focused industry, such as medical devices, healthcare, or financial services.
Experience supporting IoT products, mobile applications, connected devices, or customer-facing technology platforms.
Experience as the first or senior-most IT leader in a startup.
Relevant certifications in cloud platforms, cybersecurity, IT service management, project management, or enterprise systems.

What Success Looks Like

Tombot has a clear, prioritized IT roadmap that supports growth and product launch needs.
Core systems are secure, documented, integrated, supportable, and appropriately scalable.
CRM and ERP workflows are implemented accurately and adopted by the teams that use them.
Employee support, onboarding, offboarding, access, and equipment processes are timely and reliable.
Technology risks, outages, security issues, vendor concerns, and capacity constraints are identified early and managed effectively.
IT spending, vendor performance, service levels, and major projects are visible and well controlled.

Workplace and Travel

This role is based onsite at Tombot’s Santa Clarita, California office during standard business hours. Employees may work remotely on Flexible Fridays when business and role requirements allow. Occasional extended hours may be required for critical incidents, project deadlines, office changes, or product milestones. Travel may be required up to 10% for visits to manufacturers, suppliers, logistics partners, or company locations.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Tombot does not currently provide employment visa sponsorship. Tombot participates in E-Verify after hire and does not use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Tombot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Tombot provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Applicants who need an accommodation during the application or interview process should contact the hiring team.

is looking for an experienced and visionary Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
to lead our technology strategy, software architecture, engineering standards, and product modernization initiatives.

The CTO will play a key leadership role in transforming our existing legacy software products into modern, scalable, secure, maintainable, and future-ready platforms
using contemporary Microsoft technologies and modern software engineering practices.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with strategic thinking and leadership capability
, with experience in software architecture, .NET technologies, databases, application modernization, system integration, and engineering team management.

Define and execute the company's technology strategy and roadmap
in alignment with business objectives.
Lead the modernization and transformation of existing legacy software products and platforms
.
Establish scalable and maintainable software architecture, development standards, and engineering practices
.
Lead architecture and technology decisions involving C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST APIs, cloud technologies, and modern application frameworks
.
Evaluate existing systems and develop practical strategies for migration, refactoring, re-engineering, and modernization
.
Lead database architecture, optimization, and modernization using Microsoft SQL Server
.
Review and optimize complex SQL queries, Stored Procedures, database design, indexing, and data-access architecture
.
Establish standards for application performance, scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability
.
Drive API-first architecture and integration with internal and third-party systems.
Introduce and promote modern development practices including CI/CD, automated testing, version control, code review, DevOps, and quality assurance
.
Establish technical governance, coding standards, documentation standards, and development processes.
Conduct and lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, and code reviews
.
Identify technical risks, legacy technology limitations, and opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with the CEO, management, product, project, and business teams to translate business requirements into effective technology solutions.
Lead, mentor, and develop the software engineering team and build a strong technical culture
.
Guide developers in adopting modern technologies, design patterns, clean architecture, SOLID principles, and best practices.
Plan and manage technology resources, development priorities, technical projects, and modernization initiatives.
Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, tools, and platforms and recommend solutions based on business value and long-term sustainability.
Ensure that technology platforms are designed with appropriate security, backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, and business continuity
considerations.
Support product innovation and the development of new technology-driven solutions for the hospitality and tourism industry.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
.
3+ years of professional software development experience
, with significant experience in technical leadership or architecture roles.
Strong hands-on expertise in C# and .NET / ASP.NET Core
.
Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, design patterns, and enterprise application development
.
Extensive experience with Microsoft SQL Server
, database architecture, performance tuning, and Stored Procedures.
Strong experience with REST APIs, Web API, JSON, web services, and system integrations
.
Proven experience in legacy application modernization, migration, refactoring, and re-engineering
.
Good understanding of cloud technologies, DevOps, CI/CD, containerization, and modern deployment practices
.
Strong knowledge of Git and modern software development workflows
.
Experience with application security, performance optimization, scalability, and high-availability systems.
Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean architecture, coding standards, and software quality practices
.
Experience leading and mentoring software development teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.

Leadership Expectations

We are looking for a technology leader who can:
Think beyond individual projects and develop a long-term technology vision
.
Balance business requirements, technical quality, cost, risk, and delivery timelines
.
Take ownership of technology decisions and their long-term impact.
Build and lead a high-performing engineering team.
Create a culture of quality, accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement
.
Challenge outdated technology and processes while ensuring modernization is practical and business-focused.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Marketing Operations team drives excellence across the shared infrastructure that the marketing and sales development teams depend on: lead routing and lead management, prospect data, campaign production, marketing systems, and sales development systems. The infrastructure covers three vertical channel groups: inbound and outbound sales, digital marketing, and in-person events. We ensure that the underlying operations and systems are reliable, scalable, and well-maintained. In close partnership with Demand Generation Systems, Marketing Operations enables global and region marketers and Sales Development Representatives to focus on driving revenue rather than wrestling with operations and systems.

What you’ll do

We are looking for a Head of Marketing Operations to lead a critical team to help power Stripe's growth. You will set the direction of marketing operations, solve time-sensitive and complex operational and systems challenges, and develop managers and individual contributors. You will be an indispensable partner to peers in Marketing, Sales Development, Product Management, Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science. You will be directly responsible for a global marketing operations team of 15-20, in addition to 25-30 production specialists with a dotted-line reporting relationship.

Responsibilities

Drive excellence in the operations and systems that support inbound and outbound sales, digital marketing channels, and in-person events

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $202,200 - $303,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.
